description: Defines the QuicCryptoServerStreamBase class and related interfaces for QUIC crypto server stream handling, including methods for TLS handshake, resumption, and configuration updates.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamBase
classes.description: Abstract class for QUIC crypto server stream handling, providing methods for handshake validation, resumption control, and configuration updates.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamBase::Helper
classes.description: Interface for helper functions used by QuicCryptoServerStreamBase, including client hello acceptance policy.

methods.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the crypto server stream with a session.

methods.name: GetBase64SHA256ClientChannelID
methods.description: Retrieves the base64-encoded SHA-256 hash of the client's ChannelID.

methods.name: NumServerConfigUpdateMessagesSent
methods.description: Returns the number of server config update messages sent.

methods.name: SendServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Sends the latest server configuration and source address token.

methods.name: IsZeroRtt
methods.description: Checks if the connection was a 0-RTT resumption.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Checks if the connection was a resumption handshake.

methods.name: ResumptionAttempted
methods.description: Checks if a resumption handshake was attempted.

methods.name: EarlyDataAttempted
methods.description: Checks if early data was attempted.

methods.name: ShouldSendExpectCTHeader
methods.description: Determines if the Expect-CT header should be sent.

methods.name: DidCertMatchSni
methods.description: Checks if a certificate matched the SNI hostname.

methods.name: ProofSourceDetails
methods.description: Returns details from the latest proof source call.

methods.name: ExportKeyingMaterial
methods.description: Exports keying material; not implemented here.
